notes.basis: shelf = in-store shelf price (ALDI in-store shops, Walmart "No markups" on Instacart). online = Instacart marketplace price, which Instacart labels "Prices vary from in-store" and which can run above the shelf price.
notes.prices: Sale prices count; loyalty-card prices do not. Each state figure is the best price found at the sampled stores in that state's largest metro(s), not a statewide average.
notes.min: Within any one scope (a state block, or national) min, median and max are computed over the same set of priced stores, so min <= median <= max always holds. Shelf-only figures are the separate shelfMin/shelfMedian fields and never redefine min.
notes.states: Only states with at least 2 priced stores are reported; item.confidence (low/medium/high) reflects how many states and stores back the superlatives.
